'''Nonul Weran''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an agent of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] and specialized in undercover operations. He occasionally served as a double for fellow ISB agent [[Lesan Dos]].
